simple.meaning: properly, a verdict (favorable or unfavorable) pronounced judicially, especially a sentence or formal decree (human or (participant's) divine law , individual or collective), including the act, the place, the suit, the crime, and the penalty; abstractly, justice , including a participant's right or privilege (statutory or customary), or even a style
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מִשְׁפָּט (H4941) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 424 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
